Find the characteristic equation of the matrix B=[1−430−20−351].

(λ+2)(λ2−2λ+10)=0
c
(λ+3)(λ+2)(λ−3)=0

(λ−2)(λ2+2λ+10)=0

(λ+2)(λ2−4λ−10)=0
